copy.intro: Five seats, a real trunk and adaptive cruise control that takes the strain out of a long highway day. The Honda sedan that suits most trips.

faq.question: How many people fit in the Civic?
faq.answer: It seats five people, two in front and three in the back, and the trunk takes their bags.

faq.question: Does the Civic have all-wheel drive?
faq.answer: No. It is a 4x2 sedan, so two wheels drive it. Automatic emergency braking and lane keeping assist help on busy winter roads.

faq.question: Can I connect my phone?
faq.answer: Yes, it has Bluetooth, so you can pair your phone for calls.
